# Map: st-stm32-gpio → gpio-exti 1.0.0

Compatible: st,stm32-gpio  
Manual: RM0410 Rev 5 section 6.4; RM0433 Rev 8 section 11.4 (GPIO registers). Same layout on F7 and H7.  
Features: base

## Bindings

| Term | Register | Field | Access | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pin_mode | MODER | MODERn | rw | 00 input, 01 output, 10 alternate, 11 analog |
| output_level | ODR | ODn | rw |  |
| set_reset | BSRR | BSn, BRn | wo |  |
| input_level | IDR | IDn | ro |  |
| pin_config | ['OTYPER', 'OSPEEDR', 'PUPDR', 'AFR', 'LCKR'] |  | rw | stored only |
